A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 39-page versions of Geometry-Aware Edge Pooling for Graph Neural Networks. Their text, equations, figures, tables, checklist, and Appendices A–D support reliable comparison.

before.justification: Section 4 and Appendix D report original graph classification, regression, structure-preservation, runtime, and feature-reconstruction experiments.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix D, including numerical tables and empirical plots.

M1.justification: MagEdgePool and SpreadEdgePool retain the same edge scoring, contraction rules, feature aggregation, and Algorithm 1. The approximate distance-update variants in Appendix D.2.2 are also unchanged.

E1.justification: The datasets in Table S.2 and the classification, regression, synthetic-graph, reconstruction, and scaling scenarios remain unchanged. Table 2's MolFreesolv-to-MolFreeSolv edit only corrects capitalization.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments, including EdgePool and randomized pooling in Table S.9. Correcting Graculus to Graclus in Appendix C.5.1 does not introduce a different baseline.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendix C.5 retain the same preprocessing, architectures, metrics, training schedules, and pooling ratios, including 10-fold stratified classification evaluation and predefined OGB regression splits.

E4.justification: The pooling-ratio sensitivity, magnitude–spread correlation, computational scaling, feature reconstruction, randomized-pooling ablation, and structure-preservation analyses are retained without changes to their questions or evidence.

E5.justification: Run and seed counts, standard-deviation reporting, Wilcoxon tests with Holm–Bonferroni correction, and Friedman/Nemenyi analyses remain unchanged. The checklist's correction to model’s accuracy is grammatical.

E6.justification: The numerical results, rankings, plotted findings, and qualitative outcomes are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, SpreadEdge's ENZYMES accuracy remains 92.8 ± 1.6 in Table 1, and EdgePool's IMDB-M accuracy remains 47.6 ± 3.3 in Table S.9.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, Theorems 1–7, corollaries, complexity derivations, and proofs in Appendix B are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions, and Section 5 retain the same claims about structure-preserving edge pooling, competitive task performance, flexible pooling ratios, and spread's computational advantages.

C2.justification: Interpretations of geometry preservation and task performance remain unchanged. Section 5 and Appendix D retain the same limitations concerning homophily, redundancy, task relevance of graph structure, and scalability.

D1.justification: Appendix C retains the same software versions, hardware specifications, hyperparameters, computational details, and pseudocode. Code-access information and licensing declarations are also unchanged.

R1.justification: The introduction adds a citation to Willerton [52] when introducing spread. This is a limited citation addition: v2 already attributes spread to Willerton in Section 2.2, and the bibliography and broader research positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: v3 makes scattered spelling, grammar, punctuation, and spacing edits, including alterative to alternative and exhibit to exhibits. It also removes Bastian Rieck's Technical University of Munich affiliation. Section organization and the narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Table 2's column heading changes from MolFreesolv to MolFreeSolv, accompanied by small title-block spacing and local text-reflow changes. Figures, table structures, captions, and placement otherwise remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 supplies small editorial polish and an additional introductory citation already supported by Section 2.2. It leaves the methods, theoretical arguments, empirical evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information unchanged. These limited edits do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
